007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.VectorIndex;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015
016/**
017 * Sample for updating one Select AI vector-index attribute with the CLOB option.
018 *
019 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, obtain a
020 * {@link VectorIndex} object for an existing vector index, call
021 * {@link VectorIndex#update(String, String, boolean)}, and print whether the
022 * update succeeded.</p>
023 *
024 * <p>This sample changes database state by updating the vector index identified
025 * by {@code SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME}. Use an attribute accepted by the
026 * database for vector-index updates. Attribute mutability is determined by
027 * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI.UPDATE_VECTOR_INDEX}; if the database rejects the
028 * update, this sample logs the resulting {@link SelectAIException}.</p>
029 *
030 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
031 * <ul>
032 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
033 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME</li>
036 * </ul>
037 *
038 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
039 * <ul>
040 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_ATTRIBUTE_NAME - defaults to {@code match_limit}.</li>
041 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE - defaults to {@code 5}.</li>
042 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_ATTRIBUTE_USE_CLOB - defaults to {@code true}.</li>
043 * </ul>
044 *
045 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
046 * <pre>{@code
047 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
048 * }</pre>
049 *
050 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
051 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
052 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
053 * <pre>{@code
054 * mvn clean install
055 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
056 * }</pre>
057 *
058 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
059 * <pre>{@code
060 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
061 *   -d samples/out \
062 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/vectorindex/UpdateVectorIndexAttributeWithClobSample.java
063 * }</pre>
064 *
065 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
066 * <pre>{@code
067 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
068 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex.UpdateVectorIndexAttributeWithClobSample
069 * }</pre>
070 *
071 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
072 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
073 * and diagnostics.</p>
074 */
075public final class UpdateVectorIndexAttributeWithClobSample {
076    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(UpdateVectorIndexAttributeWithClobSample.class);
077
078    private UpdateVectorIndexAttributeWithClobSample() {
079    }
080
081    public static void main(String[] args) {
082        String indexName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME");
083        String attributeName = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_ATTRIBUTE_NAME", "match_limit");
084        String attributeValue = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE", "5");
085        boolean useClob = Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_ATTRIBUTE_USE_CLOB", "true"));
086
087        try {
088            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
089            VectorIndex vectorIndex = selectAI.vectorIndex(indexName);
090            boolean updated = vectorIndex.update(attributeName, attributeValue, useClob);
091
092            System.out.printf("Update vector index '%s' attribute '%s' with useClob=%s completed: %s%n",
093                    indexName, attributeName, useClob, updated);
094        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
095            LOGGER.error("Failed to update Select AI vector index '{}'.", indexName, e);
096        }
097    }
098
099    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
100        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
101                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
102                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
103                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
104                .build();
105
106        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
107    }
108
109    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
110        String value = System.getenv(name);
111        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
112            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
113        }
114        return value;
115    }
116
117    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
118        String value = System.getenv(name);
119        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
120    }
121}
